arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-21' AND date < '2019-10-28'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the Monday-to-Sunday week before the final week of the data, 21 to 27 October 2019.
assumptions: Last day of the data is 2019-10-31 (a Thursday), so the current partial week starts Monday 2019-10-28; 'last week' is the previous full Monday-to-Sunday week, 2019-10-21 to 2019-10-27.
Counts every transaction regardless of fraud label or error status, including those with no label.
Transactions with negative amounts are counted as transactions.
